**🎥 YouTube Title Options**

1. **Protecting Patients & Profits: How BlisCare is Revolutionizing Aesthetic Surgery Insurance**  
2. **The Financial Safety Net Every Plastic Surgeon Needs: Inside BlisCare with Suzanne Baike**

**📄 YouTube Description**

In this episode of *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge*, host **Bethany Gifford**, founder of **New Era Intel**, sits down with **Suzanne Baike**, VP of Business Development & Sales at **BlisCare**, to uncover a powerful solution reshaping financial security in aesthetics and elective surgery.  

With over **33 years in nursing**, Suzanne shares how her clinical background inspired her to help surgeons and patients safeguard their investments through **downside risk protection**—an innovative model that wraps insurance coverage around cash-pay procedures.  

💡 You’ll learn:
- What “downside risk” really means in aesthetics  
- How BlisCare protects both surgeons and patients when complications arise  
- Why bundled care and risk protection are the future of cash-pay medicine  
- How to integrate BlisCare into your practice model to prevent financial losses  

If you’re a **plastic surgeon, med spa owner, or healthcare executive**, this episode will open your eyes to a smarter, more sustainable way to operate and protect your bottom line.  

📍 **Connect with Suzanne Baike**  
🌐 [www.BlisCare.com](https://www.bliscare.com)  
📧 suzanne@bliscare.com  
🔗 LinkedIn: [Suzanne Baike](https://www.linkedin.com)

🎙️ Hosted by **Bethany Gifford**  
Founder of **New Era Intel** | Creator of the *Fully Booked CRM™* | Host of *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge*  

👉 Subscribe for more interviews with industry leaders redefining the future of aesthetics, wellness, and healthcare innovation.
